mapper.sql: id, org_id, activity_id, type, operator_account_id, status, request_key, request_fingerprint, source_hash, source_scope, protocol, model, endpoint_host, config_version, connection_revision, output_text, error_code, request_id, adopted_at, adopted_by, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_generation (org_id, activity_id, type, operator_account_id, status, request_key, request_fingerprint, source_hash, source_scope, protocol, model, endpoint_host, config_version, connection_revision) VALUES (#{orgId}, #{activityId}, #{type}, #{operatorAccountId}, #{status}, #{requestKey}, #{requestFingerprint}, #{sourceHash}, #{sourceScope}, #{protocol}, #{model}, #{endpointHost}, #{configVersion}, #{connectionRevision})
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_generation SET status = #{status}, output_text = #{outputText}, error_code = #{errorCode}, request_id = COALESCE(#{requestId}, request_id) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE ai_generation SET adopted_at = COALESCE(adopted_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)), adopted_by = COALESCE(adopted_by, #{accountId}) WHERE id = #{id}
